fixture: Frozen default v2 world generated before changes; same physical/climate arrays; change only params.landformVersion 2 → 3
method: Gray: HSV saturation < 0.15. Green: G-R > .018 and G-B > .035. Cell counts, with world area reported separately. near sample uses actual atlas grade at parent vertex plus city-layer parent seasonal snow mix. rockMix is diagnostic of original v2 code, before seasonal snow masking.
scope: Representative cell-centre/vertex material samples, not raster screenshot pixel counts. Includes city-layer seasonal parent snow preblend; shader lighting and mesh averaging not included.

fieldSemantics.vegetation: Fraction of summer substrate carrying biome-supported plant cover. Moisture, temperature and physical exposure affect it.
fieldSemantics.soil: Unvegetated soil/earth fraction, 1-vegetation-rock; dry plateaus retain soil hues.
fieldSemantics.rock: Exposed mineral fraction, from physical neighbour relief and biome cover. Not renderer slope.
fieldSemantics.rugged: Smooth qualitative exposure proxy for max neighbour height difference 300–1700m; not a measured slope or calibrated distance.
fieldSemantics.relief: Maximum absolute height difference to dry land four-neighbours, metres. Water boundaries use local height.

priority: Water, permanent snow, glaciers override substrate; all fractions are zero on protected cells. Seasonal snow is independent of summer land cover. Shared color/cache logic does not mutate world fields.

definitions.green: G-R > 0.018 and G-B > 0.035; warm dry grass can remain yellow rather than count as green.
definitions.iceFree: Dry land except ice > 25 and permanent snow/glacier biomes
definitions.wetHighlandsLittleSnow: height > 1200m, arid > .7, annual temp > -1C, model seasonal cover < .2
definitions.tablePairs: Every pair is [original v2 colors, new v3 colors on unchanged v2 physical/climate fields]
